newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibia recognises Kabila as Zaire's new leader.
newsitem.headline: Namibia recognises Kabila as Zaire's new leader.

text.p: Namibia recognised Laurent Kabila as Zaire's new leader on Tuesday and called on the international community to help rebuild the country.

The foreign ministry said in a statement that President Sam Nujoma's government fully recognised Kabila as leader of what he has renamed the Democratic Republic of Congo. The move follows recognition by Namibia's neighbours South Africa, Angola and Botswana.
"The government wholeheartedly welcomes the victory of Democratic Alliance of the Congo led by President Laurent Kabila," it said.

Namibia urged rebel leader Kabila, who declared himself head of state on Saturday after Mobutu fled, to include other political groupings in his new government and to be tolerant and work towards reconciliation.

The statement also said Namibia would endorse Zaire's application to join the Southern African Development Community, an economic frum which includes all countries to Zaire's south, if it chose to do so.
